items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions meeting Henry Grimes and asks if the interviewee's first gig was with him, but the interviewee does not confirm playing with him or express a personal relationship, only redirecting the conversation.

ctx.x: We played there every night, late. I met Henry Grimes there, and Frank Isola, and a lot of people.
Isn’t that where... Well, where did you meet George Wallington? I was thinking he was there...
